object.attr: stakeholder: the list is what an agent commits and what a person reviews; 0.2.0 fixed tools that left files out. "Exactly", because an extra or missing path breaks the commit, and git's own cache files aren't commit material (CF-M29, CF-M30, review Q4). The test hashes each file under the root before and after each write tool and compares with the list both ways.
object.description: When a write tool call succeeds, the MCP server shall list in `affected_files` exactly the files under the repository's root folder, outside git's own folder, that the call created, changed or deleted.
